basics.name: Jiwoong Heo
basics.label: Assistant Professor
basics.summary: Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Statistics at Chosun University and director of HAI2LAB (Human-AI Interaction & Intelligence Lab). My research spans transportation mode detection from mobile sensing, human–vehicle interaction in automated driving, VR/AR-based assessment, and applied large language and vision-language models.
